title: Home-Site Lease Renewal Offers — Desk System Reference
content:
The renewal offer on a fixed-term Home-Site Lease is priced from the lease records on the day the offer is issued.

## When an offer is issued

- The offer falls due the lot class's renewal offer lead days, in calendar days, before the current term end date.
- An offer that fell due and was not issued is issued, on the day the omission is found, for the term the resident asks to renew on, starting the day after the current term end date and carrying a response deadline the lot class's renewal response days, in calendar days, after that offer date.
- An offer issued on time carries one offered term for each term the lot class makes available.

| Offer | Terms recorded | First day of each term | Response deadline |
|---|---|---|---|
| issued on time | one for each term the lot class makes available | the day after the current term end date | the lot class's response days after the offer date |
| fell due and was not issued; issued on the day the omission is found | the term the resident asks to renew on | the day after the current term end date | the lot class's response days after that offer date |

*Hypothetical.* A twelve-month term ends on 30 September; the offer fell due but was never issued, and the omission is found on 2 August when the resident asks to renew for twelve months. One offered twelve-month term is recorded on 2 August, its first day 1 October, its response deadline the lot class's response days after 2 August.

## The desk tool: `issue_renewal_offer_ab5c4495`

**Capability.** Records one written renewal offer for one term on a resident's fixed-term Home-Site Lease, dated today: the term type, the first day of that term, the last day on which the resident may sign it, and the monthly site rent offered for it. Nothing is charged and the lease itself is not changed; afterwards the offered term, its rent and its deadline appear among the notices on the lease. Each call records one offered term.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `issue_renewal_offer_ab5c4495` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `lease_id` | the lease reference number of the home-site lease being offered renewal, as returned by the lease lookup for this resident | identifier |
| `offered_term_type` | the term offered | one of `twelve_month` (a fixed twelve-month term), `twenty_four_month` (a fixed twenty-four-month term), `month_to_month` (a month-to-month term with no end date) |
| `effective_date` | first day of the offered term (the day after the current term end date) | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `response_deadline` | last day on which the resident may sign the offered renewal | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `new_monthly_site_rent` | monthly site rent offered for that term | USD, two decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** On success a receipt with `status` "issued", `offer_id` (the offered term's reference number), `lease_id`, `notice_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD), `offered_term_type`, `effective_date` and `response_deadline` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `new_monthly_site_rent` (USD, two decimal places). The tool defines no error responses.

*Illustrative call (hypothetical values):* `lease_id` of the lease, `offered_term_type` `twelve_month`, `effective_date` 2026-10-01, `response_deadline` the date the response days give, `new_monthly_site_rent` 712.35 — the receipt returns status "issued" with an `offer_id`.
